title: Longest run of healthy days in an uptime log
summary: From a daily status log, find the longest run of consecutive calendar days with status ok and the date it starts.
instructions:
Below is a daily status log for one service. Each line is a date and a status: ok, degraded or down. Some days have no line at all.

Find the longest run of consecutive calendar days that all have the status ok. A day with another status, or a day with no line, ends a run. The log crosses from February into March, so work the dates out as calendar dates.

Report two things, separated by a comma: the length of that run in days, and the date of its first day as YYYY-MM-DD. If two runs are equally long, give the earlier one. For example 5,2026-01-09 means a run of 5 days that starts on 9 January.

How it is checked: your answer is compared with the correct answer after trimming spaces and ignoring upper or lower case. There is no partial credit, and the reward is paid only for a correct answer.
